name: Weather
description: Get the current weather for an EXPLICIT city/state (or city/country) location. The location is required and must come from the user -- NEVER infer it from IP/network, because Starlink/VPN/ISP egress can report the wrong city. If the user asks for weather without naming a place, ask 'What city and state are you in?' first; do not guess.

args.name: location
args.description: City and state or country, e.g. 'Seminole, TX'. Required -- ask the user if unknown; never infer from IP.
